question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'are'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The words** 'was' **and **'were'** refer to the** past tense** and are inappropriate options for the blank number (2) as the given sentence is in not in past tense.
 
• The word **'has been' **is used in **present perfect continuous** tense.
 
• Here, the** appropriate word** suitable to fill the blank in the given sentence is the word **'are' **since it is a** present tense verb**.
 
• So, the **correct statement** is: *No matter how justified or marginal our requirements (2) are__ we will occasionally be disheartened.*

Thus, the correct option is **'option 4)'**.
